coverage: I extracted every concrete claim from the skill body - every settings path, menu action, default, status-icon mapping, gotcha behaviour and Verify-step behaviour from the OneDrive, Google Drive, iCloud, Dropbox, Status icons, Gotchas and Verify sections (the skill contains no commands, flags or numbers, and the Goal line is a purpose statement rather than a product claim), split compound sentences so each claim is a verbatim substring, and checked each against all four listed sources.
suggested_edits: Only the Dropbox Preferences > Sync > Selective Sync claim is backed by a source: help.dropbox.com/sync/selective-sync-overview is the one real article among the four. The other three URLs are hub pages - the OneDrive help & learning landing page, the Google Drive Help Center homepage and the iCloud User Guide welcome page - whose text is navigation and article titles only, so every OneDrive, Google Drive and iCloud claim is uncovered: Files On-Demand default and cloud icon, Always keep on this device / Free up space, Choose folders, the gear > Preferences path, stream online-only by default, Offline access > Available offline, mirror as full copy on disk, My Computer backups, Optimise Mac Storage, Download Now / Remove Download, Keep Downloaded, the Windows iCloud right-click, the status-icon meanings, the needs-internet and backup-tools gotchas, and deleting a synced file everywhere. A fix PR should bump the version and add the real documentation pages to sources - OneDrive 'Save disk space with OneDrive Files On-Demand' and its sync/choose-folders pages, Google 'Stream & mirror files with Drive for desktop', 'Customize Drive for desktop settings' and the offline and My Computer articles, Apple's iCloud Drive and Optimise Mac Storage pages, and Dropbox's make-files-online-only and sync-icons pages - then re-run the claim checks.
